summary: SS Innovations International filed an 8-K announcing a press release on May 7, 2026, regarding the successful completion of a long-distance cross-border telesurgery using its SSi Mantra surgical robotic system. The surgery spanned over 4,500 miles from Perth, Australia to Indore, India, performed by Dr. Mohit Bhandari. This is a routine operational update on a technological achievement, not a special situation. No financial terms, deal mechanics, or strategic changes are involved.
